host_boundaries: IContext allocation and vtable layout are host-created; the pinned native View Context::GetColor method is installed at its observed slot +80.
Color is allocated by the host harness, then initialized by native Color::Color and configured by native SetColorTheme; getter confirms mode.
The context getter invokes the actual selected native theme vtable method; direct calls to that same method are compared for every sentinel.
fmod/fmodf imports used by DarkColorTheme are host libm callbacks with ARM64 f32/f64 register semantics.

drawing_theme_2_ffffffff.scope: Native Drawing caller and direct replay of its selected versioned InkPen RedrawPen entry under an explicit synthetic context/theme. Does not claim Samsung device defaults, SDK deserialization, renderer pixels, or export parity.
